title: The Alchemist Coin Dispenser
statement:
An alchemical automated bank dispenses coins of N distinct denominations. A customer requests an exact payout of Target coins.

You have an infinite supply of coins of each denomination. Determine the minimum number of coins needed to make up that amount. If that amount cannot be made up by any combination of the given coins, print -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and Target.
Second line: N space-separated integers representing coin denominations.
outputFormat: Print the minimum coins required, or -1 if impossible.

sampleCases.explanation: Target 2 cannot be made with coins of denomination 3.
